capabilities: Browse folders, tags, backlinks, outlinks and manual notes as one card stream
Cite selected text or paragraphs into a bound draft target with verified source ranges
Drag paragraph handles into a receiving editor
Collect excerpts into a desk outline and batch-insert them after a preview
Save named desks with sources, target and reading state
disambiguation: Not a syncing or file-transfer tool; it builds a reading stream of notes to cite from into a draft.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; fully local with no network requests; exporting an outline preview as a standalone Markdown file is deferred and not included in 0.1.6.
motivation: To make long-form writing effortless without jumping between tabs and split panes.
problem: Writing long-form text in Obsidian means jumping between tabs and split panes to read sources and move quotes into a draft.
summary: Sidebar card stream of notes from folders, tags and links, with verified citations, drag-to-draft and an outline for long-form writing.
